5. CHILD POLICY
• Infants–4 yrs sharing with adults: FOC (Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa only)
• Children 5–11.99 yrs sharing with adults: 50% of adult sharing rate
• Children 5–11.99 yrs in own room (min 2, max 3): 75% of adult sharing rate
• Children under 5 yrs are NOT permitted at Salt Lick Safari Lodge for safety reasons
• Connecting rooms required for children under 12 yrs (subject to availability)
6. OCCUPANCY RULES
Salt Lick Safari Lodge
• Max 3 adults OR 2 adults + 1 child
• Triple rooms are allowed only in Park View rooms
• No triple in Waterhole View rooms
• No interconnecting rooms available
Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa
• Max 3 adults OR 2 adults + 1 child
• Interconnecting rooms available
• Suites: max 2 adults + 1 child

7. TAITA HILLS WILDLIFE SANCTUARY FEES
Sanctuary Entry
• Adult: USD 45 per night
• Child (5–11.99 yrs): USD 25 per night
• Under 5 yrs: FOC
• Students (up to 23 yrs) with valid ID: USD 25 per night. Verifications of student ID will be required at check-in
• Sanctuary fees do not apply for guests staying at Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa unless they enter for game drives.
Vehicle Entry Fees
VEHICLE CAPACITY FEE PER NIGHT
4–12 SEATS $5
13–24 SEATS $10
25–44 SEATS $15
45+ SEATS $20
AIRCRAFT $20
HELICOPTER LANDING $20
8. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT & DAY ROOMS
• Check-in: 1200 hrs
• Check-out: 1000 hrs
• Day room until 1700 hrs: 50% of single/double rate, inclusive of lunch
• After 1700 hrs: charged as full night
9. WALK-IN / ADDITIONAL MEALS
• Buffet Breakfast: USD 30
• Buffet Lunch: USD 30
• Buffet Dinner: USD 30
• Picnic Box: USD 20
• Children: 50% of above rates
10. HALF BOARD REDUCTION
• HB reduction: USD 5 per adult/child per night

11. BOOKING TERMS
• Booking vouchers must be emailed to:
o Salt Lick Safari Lodge: reservations@saltlicksafarilodge.com
o Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa: reservations@taitahillssafareresort.com
• Bookings confirmed subject to availability
12. PAYMENT TERMS
• All bookings must be supported by a voucher
• Full payment 100% upon confirmation of the booking
• Cheques not accepted
13. CHRISTMAS SEASON / FESTIVE BOOKING TERMS
All bookings over the Christmas Season (22nd December and 1st January) shall attract a mandatory 100% deposit.
Non-Payment Clause: Failure to receive payments as per the timelines above will lead to automatic release of rooms without further notice.
Minimum Stay Requirement:
A minimum stay of 2 nights is applicable between 22nd December and 1st January.
Guests staying for only 1 night during this period will be charged the 2-night minimum stay rate.
14. CANCELLATION & NO-SHOW POLICY
• 30–16 days before arrival: 25% charge
• 15–8 days before arrival: 50% charge
• 7 days to arrival date: 100% charge
15. General: All standard terms and conditions of the Resort apply.
Reservations Contact Details:

Email: reservations@taitahillssafariresort.com | reservations@saltlicksafarilodge.com
